global:
  name: free5gc
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl  # supported values: "single" and "ulcl"
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16  # UE IP address pool
  nrf:
    service:
      name: nrf-nnrf
      type: ClusterIP
      port: "8000"
      nodePort: "30800"

    scheme: http

    multus:
      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments

        ipAddress: 10.100.50.249
      n2network:
        enabled: true
        name: n2network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.248
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.254
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.254

      ngap:
        enabled: true  # Enable NGAP service for external access

        port: 38412
        nodeport: 31412

      enabled: false  # Default: disabled for cloud-native deployments

        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240

        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246

          ipAddress: 10.100.50.233

        n6if:

        n4if:

          ipAddress: 10.100.100.13
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.226

        n3if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.234
        n4if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.245
        n6if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.100.14
        n9if:
          ipAddress: 10.100.50.227
      n3network:
        enabled: true
        name: n3network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.232
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.238
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.238
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246

        enabled: true

219-
220-### Enable the single UPF feature
221-
222:- The default architecture of free5gc-helm is **ULCL**.
223-
224-To enable a **single UPF**, replace the following files in `charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/`:
225-
226-1. `values.yaml`: Replace with `single-upf-values.yaml`.
227-2. `templates/smf-configmap.yaml`: Replace with `smf-configmap-single-upf.yml`.
228-3. `charts/free5gc/values.yaml`, set `global.userPlaneArchitecture` to `single`.
229-
230-### Enable the Prometheus and Grafana
231-To start Prometheus and Grafana, run the following commands to install Prometheus and Grafana using the kube-prometheus-stack chart.
232-```
233-helm repo add prometheus-community https://prometheus-community.github.io/helm-charts
234-helm repo update
235-helm install prometheus prometheus-community/kube-prometheus-stack -n <namespace>
236-```
237-
238-In values.yaml, set metrics.enable to true for each NF you want to monitor.
239-
240-Next, create a PodMonitor to tell Prometheus how to find and scrape the free5GC pods. (The namespace in prometheus.yaml must same as your free5GC deployment, default is free5gc)
241-```
242-cd ~/free5gc-helm/charts/free5gc
243-kubectl apply -f prometheus.yaml
244-```
245-
246-Now you can access the prometheus and grafana by port forwarding, for example
247-```
248-kubectl port-forward --address 0.0.0.0 prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 9090:9090 -n <namespace>
249-kubectl port-forward --address 0.0.0.0 <grafana_pod_name> 3000:3000 -n <namespace>
250-```
251-default Grafana login info : admin / prom-operator
252-

263-

266-## Customized installation
267-This chart allows you to customize its installation. The table below shows the parameters that can be modified before installing the chart or when upgrading it as well as their default values.
268-
269-### Main chart parameters
270-| Parameter | Description | Default value |
271-| --- | --- | --- |
272-| `deployMongoDB` | If `true` then the MongoDB subchart will be installed. | `true` |
273-| `deploy<NFName in capital letters>` | If `true` then the `<NFName>` subchart will be installed. `<NFName>` must be one of the following: AMF, AUSF, N3IWF, NRF, NSSF, PCF, SMF, UDM, UDR, UPF, WEBUI. | `see values.yaml` |
274-
275-### Global and subcharts' parameters
276-Please check this [link](https://helm.sh/docs/chart_template_guide/subcharts_and_globals/) to see how to customize global and subcharts' parameters.
277-
278-| Parameter | Description | Default value |
279-| --- | --- | --- |
280-| `global.projectName` | The name of the project. | `free5gc` |
281:| `global.userPlaneArchitecture` | User plane topology. Possible values are `single` and `ulcl` | `single` |
282-| `global.sbi.scheme` | The SBI scheme for all control plane NFs. Possible values are `http` and `https` | `http` |
283-| `global.nrf.service.name` | The name of the service used to expose the NRF SBI interface. | `nrf-nnrf` |
284-| `global.nrf.service.type` | The type of the NRF SBI service. | `NodePort` |
285-| `global.nrf.service.port` | The NRF SBI port number. | `8000` |
286-| `global.nrf.service.port` | The NRF SBI service nodePort number. | `30800` |
287-| `global.smf.n4if.ipAddress` | The IP address of the SMF’s N4 interface. | `10.100.50.249` |
288-| `global.amf.n2if.ipAddress` | The IP address of the AMF’s N2 interface. | `10.100.50.249` |
289-| `global.amf.service.ngap.enabled` | If `true` then a Kubernetes service will be used to expose the AMF NGAP service. | `true` |
290-| `global.amf.service.ngap.name` | The name of the AMF NGAP service. | `amf-n2` |
291-| `global.amf.service.ngap.type` | The type of the AMF NGAP service. | `ClusterIP` |
292-| `global.amf.service.ngap.port` | The AMF NGAP port number. | `38412` |
293-| `global.amf.service.ngap.nodeport` | The nodePort number to access the AMF NGAP service from outside the cluster. Used only for `NodePort` or `LoadBalancer`; set `0` for automatic allocation. | `31412` |
294-| `global.amf.service.ngap.protocol` | The protocol used for this service. | `SCTP` |
295-
296-### N2 Network parameters
297-| Parameter | Description | Default value |
298-| --- | --- | --- |
299-| `global.n2network.enabled` | If `true` then N2-related Network Attachment Definitions resources will be created. | `true` |
300-| `global.n2network.name` | N2 network name. | `n2network` |
301-| `global.n2network.masterIf` | N2 network MACVLAN master interface. | `eth0` |
302-| `global.n2network.subnetIP` | N2 network subnet IP address. | `10.100.50.248` |
303-| `global.n2network.cidr` | N2 network cidr. | `29` |
304-| `global.n2network.gatewayIP` | N2 network gateway IP address. | `10.100.50.254` |
305-
306-### N3 Network parameters
307-| Parameter | Description | Default value |
308-| --- | --- | --- |
309-| `global.n3network.enabled` | If `true` then N3-related Network Attachment Definitions resources will be created. | `true` |
310-| `global.n3network.name` | N3 network name. | `n3network` |
311-| `global.n3network.masterIf` | N3 network MACVLAN master interface. | `eth0` |

{{/*
SMF user-plane configuration for the ULCL architecture.
*/}}
{{- define "free5gc-smf.ulclConfig" -}}
smfName: SMF
snssaiInfos:
  - sNssai:
      sst: 1
      sd: 010203
    dnnInfos:
      - dnn: internet
        dnaiList:
          - mec
        dns:
          ipv4: 8.8.8.8
          ipv6: 2001:4860:4860::8888
plmnList:
  - mcc: "208"
    mnc: "93"
userplaneInformation:
  upNodes:
    gNB1:
      type: AN
    BranchingUPF:
      type: UPF
      nodeID: {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.iupf1.n4if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}IUPF1_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
      sNssaiUpfInfos:
        - sNssai:
            sst: 1
            sd: 010203
          dnnUpfInfoList:
            - dnn: internet
              dnaiList:
                - mec
      interfaces:
        - interfaceType: N3
          endpoints:
            - {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.iupf1.n3if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}IUPF1_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
          networkInstances:
            - internet
        - interfaceType: N9
          endpoints:
            - {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.iupf1.n9if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}IUPF1_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
          networkInstances:
            - internet
    AnchorUPF1:
      type: UPF
      nodeID: {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf1.n4if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}PSAUPF1_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
      sNssaiUpfInfos:
        - sNssai:
            sst: 1
            sd: 010203
          dnnUpfInfoList:
            - dnn: internet
              pools:
                - cidr: 10.60.0.0/17
      interfaces:
        - interfaceType: N9
          endpoints:
            - {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf1.n9if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}PSAUPF1_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
          networkInstances:
            - internet
    AnchorUPF2:
      type: UPF
      nodeID: {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf2.n4if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}PSAUPF2_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
      sNssaiUpfInfos:
        - sNssai:
            sst: 1
            sd: 010203
          dnnUpfInfoList:
            - dnn: internet
              pools:
                - cidr: 10.60.128.0/17
      interfaces:
        - interfaceType: N9
          endpoints:
            - {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf2.n9if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}PSAUPF2_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
          networkInstances:
            - internet
  links:
    - A: gNB1
      B: BranchingUPF
    - A: BranchingUPF
      B: AnchorUPF1
    - A: BranchingUPF
      B: AnchorUPF2
locality: area1
t3591:
  enable: true
  expireTime: 16s
  maxRetryTimes: 3
t3592:
  enable: true
  expireTime: 16s
  maxRetryTimes: 3
{{- end }}

{{/*
UE routing information for the ULCL architecture.
*/}}
{{- define "free5gc-smf.ulclUeRoutingInfo" -}}

  members:
    - imsi-208930000000001
  topology:
    - A: gNB1

  specificPath:
    - dest: 1.0.0.1/32
      path: [BranchingUPF, AnchorUPF2]

  members:
    - imsi-208930000000004
  topology:
    - A: gNB1

  specificPath:
    - dest: 10.100.100.16/32
      path: [BranchingUPF, AnchorUPF2]
{{- end }}

nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

global:
  projectName: free5gc
  userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl  # supported values: "single" and "ulcl"
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16  # UE IP address pool
  nrf:
    service:
      name: nrf-nnrf
      type: ClusterIP
      port: "8000"
      nodePort: "30800"
  sbi:
    scheme: http
  smf:
    multus:
      enabled: false
      n4if:  # PFCP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.244
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246

initcontainers:
  curl:
    registry: curlimages
    image: curl
    tag: "8.7.1"
  busybox:
    image: busybox
    tag: "1.32.0"

isPfcpNeeded: true

smf:
  name: smf
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/smf
    tag: v4.3.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: &Port 8080
  volume:
    mount: /free5gc/config/
    tlsmount: /free5gc/config/TLS
    certmount: /free5gc/cert
  podAnnotations: {}
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsUser: 1000
    runAsGroup: 1000
    runAsNonRoot: true
    fsGroup: 1000
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  securityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    exec:
      command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - |
          HEX_PORT=$(printf '%04X' "{{ .service.port }}")
          grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp || grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp6
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 1
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold:  40
    successThreshold: 1
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    exec:
      command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - |
          HEX_PORT=$(printf '%04X' "{{ .service.port }}")
          grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp || grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp6
    initialDelaySeconds: 50
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
    successThreshold: 1
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  autoscaling:
    enabled: false
    minReplicas: 1
    maxReplicas: 100
    targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
  ingress:
    enabled: false
    annotations: {}
    hosts:
      - host: chart-example.local
        paths: []
    tls: []
  configuration:
    sbi:
      tls:
        verify: false # Verify outgoing SBI HTTPS certificates
    serviceNameList: |-
        - nsmf-pdusession
        - nsmf-event-exposure
        - nsmf-oam
    urrConfiguration: |-
      urrPeriod: 10 # default usage report period in seconds
      urrThreshold: 1000 # default usage report threshold in bytes
      requestedUnit: 1000
    metrics:
      enable: false # (Optional, default false)
      scheme: http # (Required) the protocol for metrics (http or https, default https)
      port: 9091 # (Optional, default 9091) port used to bind the service
      namespace: free5gc # (Optional, default free5gc)

    logger: # log output setting
      enable: true # true or false
      level: trace # how detailed to output, value: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, panic
      reportCaller: false # enable the caller report or not, value: true or false

data:

    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf2.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf2.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf2.n9if.ipAddress }}
          type: N9
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N9
{{- end }}

          # ifname: gtpif

    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup iptables for NAT via dedicated interfaces
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE  # route traffic comming from the UE SUBNET to the interface N6

  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.iupf1.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.iupf1.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: 0.0.0.0
          type: N3
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.iupf1.n9if.ipAddress }}
          type: N9
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N9
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup iptables for NAT via dedicated interfaces
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE  # Allow routing traffic comming from the UE SUBNET to the interface N6
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o n9 -j MASQUERADE
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o n3 -j MASQUERADE

    {{- if $.Values.iupf1.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.iupf1.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] iupf1 Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] iupf1 PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    # Note: Route for UE subnet will be automatically added by UPF based on dnnList configuration
    # No need to manually add route here

    # Setup iptables for NAT (single interface mode - eth0)
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    # NAT traffic from UE subnet going out via eth0 (for uplink to internet)
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE

    {{- if $.Values.iupf1.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.iupf1.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | toYaml | indent 2 }}
    {{- end }}

    echo "[wrapper] Starting iupf1 with dynamic config"
    exec /free5gc/upf -c /tmp/upfcfg.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

      mcs: false
    uacAcc:
      normalClass: 0
      class11: false
      class12: false
      class13: false
      class14: false
      class15: false
    sessions:
      - type: "IPv4"
        apn: "internet"
        slice:
          sst: 0x01
          sd: 0x010203
    configured-nssai:
      - sst: 0x01
        sd: 0x010203
    default-nssai:
      - sst: 1
        sd: 1
    integrity:
      IA1: true
      IA2: true
      IA3: true
    ciphering:
      EA1: true
      EA2: true
      EA3: true
    integrityMaxRate:
      uplink: "full"
      downlink: "full"

    connectivity:
      name: ue-connectivity-test

      configmap:
        name: connectivity-test-configmap
      volume:
        name: connectivity-test-volume
        mount: /scripts
      ttlseconds: 50

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .configmap.name }}
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.projectName }}
    component: {{ .name }}
data:
  gnb-config.yaml: |

    {{- .configuration | nindent 4 }}
    
{{- if $.Values.global.gnb.multus.enabled }}
    linkIp: 0.0.0.0   # gNB's local IP address for Radio Link Simulation (listen on all interfaces for UE connection)
{{- if .amf.service.ngap.enabled }}
    ngapIp: 0.0.0.0
{{- else }}
    ngapIp: {{ .n2if.ipAddress }} 
{{- end }}
    gtpIp: {{ .n3if.ipAddress }}    # gNB's local IP address for N3 Interface
    
    # List of AMF address information
    amfConfigs:
      - address: {{ .amf.n2if.ipAddress }}
        port: {{ .amf.n2if.port }}
{{- else }}
    linkIp: GNB_POD_IP   # gNB's local IP address for Radio Link Simulation
    ngapIp: GNB_POD_IP   # gNB's local IP address for N2 Interface
    gtpIp: GNB_POD_IP    # gNB's local IP address for N3 Interface
    
    # List of AMF address information
    amfConfigs:
      - address: {{ $.Values.global.free5gcReleaseName }}-{{ .amf.n2if.serviceName }}
        port: {{ .amf.n2if.port }}
{{- end }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e
    
{{- if $.Values.global.gnb.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs are configured, run gNB directly
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using static IP configuration"
    exec ./nr-gnb -c /ueransim/config/gnb-config.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"
    
    # Copy config to writable location
    cp /ueransim/config/gnb-config.yaml /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    
    # Replace POD_IP placeholder
    sed -i "s/GNB_POD_IP/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Configuration prepared:"
    cat /tmp/gnb-config.yaml | grep -E "linkIp|ngapIp|gtpIp"
    
    # Execute gNB
    exec ./nr-gnb -c /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

content.thinking: SMF v4.3.0 的二進位已含 ULCL 流程，但 chart 沒開啟 `ulcl: true`，所以 SMF 以單一路徑運作；我現在補上這個設定。

input.command:
cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('smfName: SMF\n','smfName: SMF\nulcl: true   # enable SMF ULCL / branching-point procedures (otherwise uerouting.yaml specificPath is ignored)\n',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
head -8 charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl
helm upgrade free5gc-helm charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f values-override.yaml >/dev/null && kubectl -n free5gc rollout status deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf --timeout=200s; kubectl -n free5gc exec deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf -- grep -n ulcl /tmp/smfcfg.yaml

cd /home/vagrant/work/deploy; python3 - <<'EOF'
p='charts/free5gc/charts/free5gc-smf/templates/_smf-ulcl.tpl'
s=open(p).read()
i=s.index('    AnchorUPF2:')
head,tail=s[:i],s[i:]
old='''      interfaces:
        - interfaceType: N9'''
new='''      interfaces:
        # Workaround for SMF v4.3.0 BPManager.SelectPSA2 bug (fixed upstream in smf a510e92): it requires the
        # PSA node itself to declare an N3 interface for the DNN, else the ULCL path is skipped ("DNN mismatch").
        - interfaceType: N3
          endpoints:
            - {{ if .Values.global.smf.multus.enabled }}{{ .Values.global.upf.multus.psaupf2.n9if.ipAddress }}{{ else }}PSAUPF2_SERVICE_NAME{{ end }}
          networkInstances:
            - internet
        - interfaceType: N9'''
tail=tail.replace(old,new,1)

content.text: 為了乾淨狀態，依序重啟 UPF → SMF → gNB → UE（SMF 啟動時才解析 UPF IP，所以順序要對）。

input.command:
set -e; N=free5gc
kubectl -n $N scale deploy/ueransim-ue deploy/ueransim-gnb --replicas=0 >/dev/null
kubectl -n $N rollout restart deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-iupf1 deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-psaupf1 deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-psaupf2 >/dev/null
for d in iupf1 psaupf1 psaupf2; do kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-upf-$d --timeout=150s; done
kubectl -n $N rollout restart deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf >/dev/null; kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/free5gc-helm-free5gc-smf-smf --timeout=200s
kubectl -n $N scale deploy/ueransim-gnb --replicas=1 >/dev/null; kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/ueransim-gnb --timeout=120s
kubectl -n $N scale deploy/ueransim-ue --replicas=1 >/dev/null; sleep 5; kubectl -n $N rollout status deploy/ueransim-ue --timeout=120s; sleep 20
kubectl -n $N get pods -o wide | grep -E "upf|smf|ueransim" | awk '{print $1,$3,$6}'; kubectl -n $N logs deploy/ueransim-ue | grep -v debug | tail -4
